question: What survives if the virtual Great-Pyramid operator is translated to Kamil but is NOT allowed any horizontal rotation or free steering?

geometry_formulae.fixed_axis_property: For fixed site latitude, altitude and azimuth, the terrestrial axis traces one constant celestial declination as Earth rotates; time changes RA but cannot repair a declination mismatch.

primary_rigid_operators.definition: King's Chamber southern shaft reference preserved as SOUTH after translation; no azimuth rotation allowed.

The 51.84-degree face slope is a plane property, not intrinsically a beam. For continuity with the prior operator, four cardinal uphill/downhill tangent directions are retained as a structural control; they are not treated as optical surface normals.
Apex beam frozen as local zenith; no steering allowed.

face_normal_secondary_control.reason: For reflection/emission physics, a face plane's normal is the relevant orientation, and for a 51.84-degree slope its upward outward normal is 38.16 degrees above the horizon. This is therefore exported as a secondary correction rather than silently replacing the preregistered operator.
face_normal_secondary_control.conclusion: Even the physically motivated normal interpretation does not rescue the 0.25-degree alignment gate.

january_2026_control.principle: A full January scan cannot beat the all-time declination floor for a rigid terrestrial axis.
january_2026_control.zero_window_statement: No primary rigid operator reaches LOVE or EDEM within 0.25 degrees at any time in January 2026; in fact no time anywhere in the sidereal cycle can do so under the frozen J2000 approximation.

at_previous_free_azimuth_EDEM_44_5_cross.interpretation: The previous exact EDEM altitude crossing at 44.5 degrees existed only because azimuth was allowed to rotate to about 291 degrees. The actual rigid SOUTH 44.5-degree shaft is nowhere near EDEM at that instant.

isotropic_sky_null.single_target_metric: minimum absolute declination residual to any PRIMARY rigid operator axis; smaller is better

LOVE.interpretation: Not unusual. About 64.4 percent of random sky directions fit the primary rigid operator declination set at least this well.

EDEM.interpretation: Not unusual. About 44.1 percent of random sky directions fit at least this well.

isotropic_sky_null.pair_metric: Hold LOVE-EDEM separation fixed at 90.586788289 degrees, apply a random uniform 3D rotation to the pair, require two distinct PRIMARY rigid operators, and minimize the maximum of the two endpoint declination residuals.

orthogonal_route_control.note: The near-right-angle geometry survives as a deterministic curiosity but does not pass the frozen exact-orthogonality gate.

kamil_impact_control.note: The rigid pyramid operators are not promoted as the Kamil impactor trajectory.

source_notes.source: Virginia Trimble, Astronomical Investigation Concerning the So-Called Air-Shafts of Cheops' Pyramid, 1964; Harvard Digital Giza copy/catalog
source_notes.supports: southern King's Chamber shaft reference angle about 44.5 degrees and north-south shaft geometry

source_notes.source: Journal of Ancient Egyptian Architecture / National Museums Scotland casing-stone measurement discussion
source_notes.supports: Great Pyramid face slope approximately 51.84 degrees

source_notes.source: Urbini et al. / NRIAG Kamil crater geological and geophysical investigation
source_notes.supports: moderately oblique impact from NW, approximately 30-45 degrees, azimuth corridor about 305-340 degrees

reverse_pass.BACK: Remove free azimuth from the prior altitude-only operator.
reverse_pass.FORWARD: Translate the rigid cardinal pyramid frame to Kamil without rotation.
reverse_pass.LEFT: Test shaft 44.5, face 51.84 and apex vertical independently.
reverse_pass.RIGHT: Export face-normal physics as a secondary non-primary control instead of silently changing the operator.
reverse_pass.FORWARD_AGAIN: Run January and all-time declination floors plus isotropic single-target and fixed-separation pair nulls.
reverse_pass.BACK_AGAIN: Reject any alignment that exists only after reintroducing free azimuth or steering.

next_gate.name: INDEPENDENT_EPOCH_AND_ARCHITECTURAL_UNCERTAINTY_REPLICATION_V1
only_if_continued: propagate real shaft survey uncertainty instead of a single 44.5-degree nominal value
precess LOVE/EDEM coordinates to selected historical epochs only where physically meaningful
freeze one historical epoch before looking at fit
retain Kamil impact direction as an independent negative control
do not permit free azimuth unless the hypothesis explicitly includes a physical rotation mechanism
